package.description: GAMA is an easy-to-use open source modeling and simulation environment for creating spatially explicit agent-based simulations.

en-US.description: GAMA is an easy-to-use open source modeling and simulation environment for creating spatially explicit agent-based simulations.
en-US.longDescription: GAMA is an easy-to-use open source modeling and simulation environment for creating spatially explicit agent-based simulations. It has been developed to be used in any application domain: urban mobility, climate change adaptation, epidemiology, disaster evacuation strategy design, urban planning, are some of the application domains in which GAMA users are involved and for which they create models.
en-US.name: Gama
